This component mostly fires on the `<|im_end|>` token that closes an assistant reply, especially after a code block's closing ``` or a final sentence. At `<|im_end|>` it has a tiny effect, nudging the model toward a single newline rather than a double newline or end-of-text. On the mid-text tokens it slightly shifts the choice among plausible continuations.
